**Subhasish Mukherjee and Ian Tice.** "On a scale of anisotropic Sobolev spaces."
*Communications on Pure and Applied Analysis* **23** (2024), no. 9, 1240–1260.

[arXiv:2312.06044](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.06044) ·
[Journal (DOI: 10.3934/cpaa.2024055)](https://doi.org/10.3934/cpaa.2024055) ·
[PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2312.06044)

## Abstract

We introduce a scale of anisotropic Sobolev spaces defined through a three-parameter
family of Fourier multipliers and study their functional analytic properties. These
spaces arise naturally in PDE when studying traveling wave solutions, and we give some
simple applications of the spaces in this direction.
